title: ITシステムと経営
subtitle: IT Systems for Management
educationalGoal: This course is a specialized core class to achieve the specialized core “IT utilization ability” goal of the Department of Management Information. Students will learn Python, a general-purpose programming language, so that they can create simple tools for data analysis.
advice: Students will learn the basics and application of Python by completing a number of programming exercises. By actually writing programs, students will produce a tool that will perform data analysis; they will then use the tool on open data. Simply running the program in class is not sufficient; students will need to actually run the program on their own, especially as a means of review.
requiredKnowledge: Students should have a knowledge of general corporate management and information technology by taking other classes. It is assumed that students will have an understanding of Web design, IT system basics, database management, programming basics, and applied programming; these topics should be reviewed as necessary.

Be able to explain machine learning using Python.
